snippet.title: You Can't Scare Me - Official Game Overview Trailer | Dames 4 Games Halloween Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Take a look at the Game Overview Trailer for You Can't Scare Me, a VR haunted house game developed by LunaBeat. Players will set traps, become frightning monsters, and attempt to scare other players where screams earn points for the victor. You Can't Scare Me is coming soon to Steam with the game being available now for Meta Quest.
